arxiv-2106-03541.title: Multi-agent Battery Storage Management using MPC-based Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2106-03541.creator: Arash Bahari Kordabad, Wenqi Cai, Sebastien Gros
arxiv-2106-03541.description: Abstract In this paper, we present the use of Model Predictive Control (MPC) based on Reinforcement Learning (RL) to find the optimal policy for a multi-agent battery storage system. A time-varying prediction of the power price and production-demand uncertainty are considered.

arxiv-2212-11128.title: BDSP: A Fair Blockchain-enabled Framework for Privacy-Enhanced Enterprise Data Sharing
arxiv-2212-11128.creator: Lam Duc Nguyen, James Hoang, Qin Wang, Qinghua Lu, Sherry Xu, and Shiping Chen
arxiv-2212-11128.description: Abstract Across industries, there is an ever-increasing rate of data sharing for collaboration and innovation between organizations and their customers, partners, suppliers, and internal teams. However, many enterprises are restricted from freely sharing data due to regulatory restrictions across different regions, performance issues in moving large volume data, or requirements to maintain autonomy.

arxiv-2302-04010.title: Transport properties of a 1000-nm HgTe film: the interplay of surface and bulk carriers
arxiv-2302-04010.creator: M. L. Savchenko, D. A. Kozlov, N. N. Mikhailov, S. A. Dvoretsky, Z. D. Kvon
arxiv-2302-04010.description: Abstract We report on systematic study of transport properties of a 1000-nm HgTe film. Unlike to thinner and strained HgTe films, which are known as high-quality three-dimensional (3D) topological insulators, the film under study is much thicker than the limit of pseudomorphic growth of HgTe on a CdTe substrate.

arxiv-2406-02367.title: A Note on and Generalization of “Exploring Modified Kaniadakis Entropy: MOND Theory and the Bekenstein Bound Conjecture”
arxiv-2406-02367.creator: Julius Lehmann
arxiv-2406-02367.description: Abstract In a recent paper by Ambrósio et al. [ 3 ] , it was shown that the gravitational force law of the Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) phenomenology can be derived within the framework of entropic gravity and the holographic principle by assuming an entropy function other than the conventional Boltzmann-Gibbs entropy.

arxiv-2406-03755.title: Flavor-independent yield of high- 𝒑 𝑻 p_{T} hadrons from nuclear collisions
arxiv-2406-03755.creator: B. Z. Kopeliovich 1, J. Nemchik 2,3
arxiv-2406-03755.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by B. Z. Kopeliovich 1, J. Nemchik 2,3. Data on high- p T p_{T} hadron production in heavy ion collisions at Feynman x F = 0 x_{F}=0 indicate at universality of the observed nuclear suppression. Our analysis of the production mechanisms demonstrates important role of the color transparency effects which make the survival probability of a quark-antiquark dipole independent of the quark flavor, provided that the hadron wave function is formed outside the medium.

arxiv-2409-00069.title: How to Measure Human-AI Prediction Accuracy in Explainable AI Systems
arxiv-2409-00069.creator: Sujay Koujalgi, Andrew Anderson, Iyadunni Adenuga, Shikha Soneji, Rupika Dikkala, Teresita Guzman Nader, Leo Soccio, Sourav Panda, Rupak Kumar Das, Margaret Burnett, Jonathan Dodge
arxiv-2409-00069.description: Abstract . Assessing an AI system’s behavior—particularly in Explainable AI Systems—is sometimes done empirically, by measuring people’s abilities to predict the agent’s next move—but how to perform such measurements? In empirical studies with humans, an obvious approach is to frame the task as binary (i.e., prediction is either right or wrong), but this does not scale.

arxiv-2409-09800.title: Accuracy of the Ensemble Kalman Filter in the Near-Linear Setting
arxiv-2409-09800.creator: E. Calvello a,, P. Monmarché b,, A. M. Stuart c,, U. Vaes d,
arxiv-2409-09800.description: Abstract The filtering distribution captures the statistics of the state of a dynamical system from partial and noisy observations. Classical particle filters provably approximate this distribution in quite general settings; however they behave poorly for high dimensional problems, suffering weight collapse. This issue is circumvented by the ensemble Kalman filter which is an equal-weight interacting particle system.

arxiv-2501-14182.title: Single-weight Model Editing for Post-hoc Spurious Correlation Neutralization
arxiv-2501-14182.creator: Shahin Hakemi, Naveed Akhtar, Ghulam Mubashar Hassan, Ajmal Mian
arxiv-2501-14182.description: Abstract \justifying Neural network training tends to exploit the simplest features as shortcuts to greedily minimize training loss. However, some of these features might be spuriously correlated with the target labels, leading to incorrect predictions by the model. Several methods have been proposed to address this issue.

arxiv-2505-02642.title: Time-delayed collective dynamics in waveguide QED and bosonic quantum networks
arxiv-2505-02642.creator: Carlos Barahona-Pascual, Hong Jiang, Alan C. Santos, Juan José García-Ripoll
arxiv-2505-02642.description: Abstract This work introduces a theoretical framework to model the collective dynamics of quantum emitters in highly non-Markovian environments, interacting through the exchange of photons with significant retardations. The formalism consists on a set of coupled delay differential equations for the emitter’s polarizations σ i ± \sigma^{\pm}_{i} , supplemented by input-output relations that describe the field mediating the interactions.

arxiv-2505-23669.title: Dual-Task Graph Neural Network for Joint Seizure Onset Zone Localization and Outcome Prediction using Stereo EEG
arxiv-2505-23669.creator: Syeda Abeera Amir, Artur Agaronyan, William Gaillard, Chima Oluigbo, Syed Muhammad Anwar
arxiv-2505-23669.description: Abstract Accurately localizing the brain regions that triggers seizures and predicting whether a patient will be seizure-free after surgery are vital for surgical planning and patient management in drug-resistant epilepsy. Stereo-electroencephalography (sEEG) delivers high-fidelity intracranial recordings that enable clinicians to precisely locate epileptogenic networks. However, the clinical identification is subjective and dependent on the expertise of the clinical team.

arxiv-2507-02899.title: Learning to Generate Vectorized Maps at Intersections with Multiple Roadside Cameras Thanks: *Corresponding author: Miao Fan (miao.fan@ieee.org), professor at Beijing Institute of Graphic Communication, senior member of IEEE.
arxiv-2507-02899.creator: Quanxin Zheng, Miao Fan, Shengtong Xu, Linghe Kong, Haoyi Xiong
arxiv-2507-02899.description: Abstract Vectorized maps are indispensable for precise navigation and the safe operation of autonomous vehicles. Traditional methods for constructing these maps fall into two categories: offline techniques, which rely on expensive, labor-intensive LiDAR data collection and manual annotation, and online approaches that use onboard cameras to reduce costs but suffer from limited performance, especially at complex intersections.

pmc-11867668.title: Development and validation of a predictive model for pulmonary infection risk in patients with traumatic brain injury in the ICU: a retrospective cohort study based on MIMIC-IV
pmc-11867668.creator: Yulin Shi, Yong Hu, Guo Meng Xu, Yaoqi Ke
pmc-11867668.description: ObjectiveTo develop a nomogram for predicting occurrence of secondary pulmonary infection in patients with critically traumatic brain injury (TBI) during their stay in the intensive care unit, to further optimise personalised treatment for patients and support the development of effective, evidence-based prevention and intervention strategies.

pmc-11905393.title: Prevalence of hepatitis E virus in swine in China: a systematic review with meta-analysis (2004–2023)
pmc-11905393.creator: Zhenwen He, Dingyu Liu, Baoling Liu, Pian Zhang, Xiaohu Wang, Gang Wang, Yuan Huang, Jing Chen, Rujian Cai
pmc-11905393.description: IntroductionHepatitis E virus (HEV) is a major cause of acute hepatitis in humans and recognized as a zoonotic pathogen, with swine serving as a primary reservoir. Despite substantial research, comprehensive analysis encompassing regional variations and pig growth stages within China, as well as the influence of recent biosecurity measures on HEV prevalence, remains limited.

pmc-12366140.title: Expression of endogenous Anopheles gambiae microRNAs using an Anopheles gambiae densovirus (AgDNV) intronic expression system
pmc-12366140.creator: Rebecca M. Johnson, Hillery C. Metz, Yasutsugu Suzuki, Kyle J. McLean, Jason L. Rasgon
pmc-12366140.description: BackgroundAnopheles gambiae densovirus (AgDNV) is a highly species-specific parvovirus that reaches high titers in adult Anopheles gambiae mosquitoes with few transcriptomic effects and minimal significant fitness effects. Given these characteristics, AgDNV has been proposed as a viral vector for basic research and mosquito control.

pmc-12641799.title: Pulmonary Veno-Occlusive Disease: A Comprehensive Review of Diagnostic Challenges, Therapeutic Limitations, and Evolving Management
pmc-12641799.creator: Brian Foster, Sikandar Khan, Ana Suarez Gonzalez, Samantha Gillenwater, Sebastian Majewski
pmc-12641799.description: Pulmonary veno-occlusive disease (PVOD) is a rare and under-recognized cause of pulmonary hypertension. It is characterized by fibrotic obstruction of small pulmonary veins and venules. Its clinical presentation closely mimics pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH), leading to frequent misdiagnosis, delayed recognition, and potentially harmful exposure to PAH-specific vasodilator therapy.

pmc-13095308.title: A rare and severe complication in a patient who underwent percutaneous endoscopic lumbar discectomy: A case report
pmc-13095308.creator: Yuxiang Wang, Yanyu Qi, Rong Huang, Xiangjing Kong, Shoushi Wang
pmc-13095308.description: Rationale:Percutaneous endoscopic lumbar discectomy is widely performed under general anesthesia. Acute intracranial hypertension caused by massive cerebrospinal fluid loading via an unrecognized dural tear is an under-reported, potentially fatal complication that may be masked by anesthesia.Patient concerns:A 64-year-old woman underwent elective L3–L4 endoscopic discectomy. Intraoperatively, she developed refractory hypertension, followed by generalized tonic-clonic seizures and altered consciousness shortly after extubation.

pmc-13416680.title: Measuring disparate impact in human and machine decisions
pmc-13416680.creator: Jongbin Jung, Sam Corbett-Davies, Johann D. Gaebler, Ravi Shroff, Sharad Goel
pmc-13416680.description: SignificanceEmpirical studies of discrimination typically aim to estimate the effects of race and other legally protected characteristics on decisions. That goal, however, reflects an understanding of discrimination that fails to capture broader concerns of bias even when decisions are formally “race-blind.

pmc-13430033.title: Quality of life in Australian patients with central disorders of hypersomnolence
pmc-13430033.creator: Stephen Kinder, Sara Winter, Brett Duce, Claire M Ellender
pmc-13430033.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). eports a significantly reduced health-related quality of life compared to the general population, and to a greater extent than those with epilepsy or diabetes [2]. No studies from Australia were included in this large systematic review.

pmc-13454127.title: Multiple source enrichment model of organic matter in fifth member of Xujiahe Formation of Upper Triassic, northeastern Sichuan Basin
pmc-13454127.creator: Junhui Li, Youzhi Wang, Xiandong Wang, Ce An, Shun He, Tingting Shen, Di Zhang, Xiaohui Li, Wencan He
pmc-13454127.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In order to clarify the heterogeneity of organic sources in the Upper Triassic fifth member of the Xujiahe Formation (T3x5) on the northeastern margin of the Sichuan Basin, three typical wells (DS2, LQ1, PA3) were selected. Using petrology, organic geochemistry, biomarkers, kerogen maceral analysis, and rock pyrolysis, the sedimentary environment and organic matter (OM) sources were investigated, leading to a multi-source OM enrichment model. Results distinguish three sedimentary facies and corresponding OM assemblages.

pmc-13542538.title: Bilateral breast metastatic rectal cancer with MET gene amplification: A rare case report
pmc-13542538.creator: Dung Thi Nguyen, Thanh Huy Nguyen, Ha Thu Le, Hien Thu Truong
pmc-13542538.description: Breast metastases originating from colorectal cancer are extremely rare, accounting for <0.5% of all malignant lesions of the breast and are often associated with histopathological forms with a poor prognosis, such as mucinous or signet-ring cells, in which bilateral breast metastases are even rarer. In this case report, we present a female patient in her early 50s.

pmc-13584279.title: Clinical malaria recurrence and associated factors in infancy following IPTp-DP versus IPTp-SP in Busia, Uganda; a secondary analysis using the Conditional Frailty model
pmc-13584279.creator: Edward Ikoona, Adoke Yeka, Charles Natuhamya, Samuel Munyole, Fiona Agweng, Paul Mubiri, Josephine Tumuhamye, John Ssenkusu
pmc-13584279.description: BackgroundIn sub-Saharan Africa, malaria remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality in children under five. Recurrent malaria not only increases the risk of severe anaemia and developmental delays in infants, but also presents unique challenges for statistical modelling, as episodes are often correlated.
